_README: PRUNE CANDIDATES ONLY. `dead` and `recipes` are the actionable lists: nothing in the flow,
no notebook and no webapp route reads them. Everything else in this file exists to stop a
future session from re-deriving a prune list by reference counting.
WHY THIS FILE WAS REWRITTEN. Until 2026-09-03 `dead` carried 26 datasets and `recipes` 25,
produced before the Target Prioritizer webapp existed. Thirteen of those datasets had since
been deleted, and of the thirteen still live, ELEVEN are read by the deployed webapp or by a
notebook. Executing the old list would have broken Acts 1, 2 and 3. Reference counting alone
flags the whole serving layer; zone membership plus a code scan is what separates it.
This file is hand-maintained. No tool generates or reads it. Re-verify before acting on it.
verified_against: live DEMO_TARGET_IDENTIFICATION: 91 datasets, 89 recipes, 17 zones; recipe I/O graph via `dku recipe get`; code scan over webapp/backend/**/*.py and notebooks/*.py

keep_do_not_prune.breast_panel_metrics: DO NOT MIGRATE OR PRUNE, despite being zone-90 notebook evidence like the other two. Three independent systems depend on it: it is the entire build-governance allowed_targets allowlist with three immutable pilot artifacts fingerprinting its recipe settings, schema, data and metrics; it backs governed claim TI-VAL-009, whose authority is nb4 section 8.10 '8.10 HER2+ AUC'; and compute_breast_panel is one of three IDENTITY_RECIPES under DEC-OPS-006, whose check fails if the dss_recipes/ mirror is missing.

already_deleted._note: Removed from live DSS. Retained so a future session does not re-flag them as findings. The top50_* and pairwise_* branches were superseded by the family_panel_* datasets in zone A3. `dashboard_persona_trust` and `join_trust_for_personas` were deleted 2026-09-03 with user approval as the release flow-freeze; both inputs of that join (persona_candidates, disease_pool_sizes) survived with other consumers, and zone A4 dropped from 3 datasets to 2. `tractability_axis` and `compute_tractability_axis` were deleted 2026-09-03 after their logic moved into tools/nb_assertions/derive.py: equality was verified first (same 1,336x48 shape, max absolute difference 2.8e-14) and the full assertion suite then passed with 150 checks and 0 stale. Zone 90 was dissolved in the same pass -- breast_panel_metrics went to 31 beside scored_champion, pool_reachability to A4 beside known_drug_truth. Folding both into 31 was measured and rejected: it created three zone cycles.

shared_recipe_caution._note: RESOLVED 2026-09-03, retained as the lesson. The hazard: a dataset may go while its producing recipe must not, because the recipe has a second output that something reads. The live example used to be `pool_unreachable_targets` -- unread, but produced by `compute_pool_reachability` alongside `pool_reachability`, which nb2 reads. That dataset has since been deleted and the recipe now has a single output, so the example is history. No recipe in the flow currently has this shape; `tools/build_flow_map.py` recomputes the check on every run rather than asserting a fixed example, so it cannot outlive the hazard again.

dead_detail._note: Empty. The flow has no prune candidates: the only unreferenced dataset left is `llm_hx`, a deliberate KEEP. Any future entry needs the same two-part evidence: no recipe input AND no hit in a code scan over webapp/backend and notebooks.
